## Human review
Comment on report lines or reference an issue ID. Questions, severity changes and accepted deferrals will be recorded in normal commits without renumbering issues.

## Publication and lifecycle
- [ ] Public report checked for credentials, private host/path/account data and nonpublic source excerpts.
- [ ] Findings have immutable anchors, evidence limits and existing-discussion links.
- [ ] Two reader-action links and editable drafts include this report PR backlink.
- [ ] Target head is current, or report prominently marked stale.
- [ ] No automatic target feedback or merge implied.

Report PR remains open while target is open. After target merge/closure, record outcomes and request maintainer archival merge. Template is proposed until human acceptance.
